meta.subtitle: Target architecture, not a claim of current implementation.

views.label: Keep native owners
views.note: One owner per obligation, current consumers and a bounded lifecycle; ETHOS binds rather than clones.

views.label: Preserve exact evidence
views.note: Durable evidence survives transient execution without granting permission.

views.label: Derive outward
views.note: Sources and durable results feed rebuildable views. No view reverse-owns its source.

cards.title: Anatomy is not an execution sequence
items: Containment identifies the repository owner. It does not mean the repository object executes a task, authorizes a mutation or normalizes native layouts.

Agentic-native source, tests, specs, docs, rules and Skills follow one semantic owner per obligation and executable quality. Each module, config, document and temporary resource needs a current consumer and bounded lifecycle. Profiles retain native domain, layout, provider and observation freedom; governed mutation uses verified OpenSpec.

cards.title: Sources and results have different responsibilities
items: Attestation is the sole durable semantic result, scoped by predicate, bindings, validity and verifier, never permission. Commitment, Facts and Plan are transient. Change relations and experiments are derived: no persistent workflow graph, compatibility residue, feedback ledger or memory-backed truth.
The evidence store preserves content-addressed receipts and their supporting material; it is not another semantic authority.

cards.title: Projection is outward, not reciprocal authority
items: CLI/JSON, SDK, CI/Forge and optional MCP/A2A project the same verdict and gaps. Code graphs and dashboards are rebuildable observations, not intent or authority.
A derived view can be rebuilt. A new claim must be supported by promoted native source or exact evidence, not by a dashboard, assistant transcript or generated summary.
